files.devhost.toml:
name = 'full'
[worktrees]
enabled = false
[devtools]
idleTimeout = '5m'
[devtools.chat]
enabled = false
prompt = 'custom'
[devtools.annotations]
enabled = false
[devtools.configEditor]
enabled = true
[devtools.externalToolbars]
enabled = false
[devtools.minimap]
enabled = false
[devtools.editor]
enabled = true
ide = 'cursor'
[devtools.status]
enabled = true
position = 'top-right'
[devtools.shortcuts]
restartServices = 'alt+r'
[devtools.resources]
enabled = true
pollInterval = '1s'
[devtools.resources.cpu]
pollInterval = '500ms'
[services.web]
command = ['web']
port = 3000
host = ['web', 'web-alt.localhost']
path = '/'
proxyLocalOrigin = true
bindHost = '127.0.0.1'
injectPort = true
[services.web.env]
FOO = 'bar'
[services.web.health]
http = '/health'
interval = 100
timeout = 5000
retries = 2

name = 'bad'
[worktrees]
enabled = 'no'
[devtools]
idleTimeout = 'not-a-dur'
unknown = 1
[devtools.editor]
ide = 'emacs'
[devtools.status]
position = 'left'
[devtools.resources]
pollInterval = '10ms'
[services.web]
command = ['web']
port = 3000

name = 'bad'
[services.web]
command = ['web']
host = ['web', 'WEB']
path = 'relative'
proxyLocalOrigin = true
[services.web.health]
process = true
[services.api]
command = ['api']
[services.api.health]
http = '/ready'

name = 'overlap'
[services.a]
command = ['a']
port = 4000
host = 'app.localhost'
path = '/api/*'
[services.b]
command = ['b']
port = 4000
bindHost = '0.0.0.0'
host = 'app.localhost'
path = '/api/v1'

name = 'multi'
[services.web]
command = ['web']
port = 3000
[services.web.health]
tcp = 3000
process = true

name = 'unmanaged'
[services.ext]
managed = false
injectPort = true
[services.ext.health]
process = true
